reading:
Iron Mountain Incorporated is a publicly traded REIT, trading as IRM, SEC filer CIK 0001020569, headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. Its core business is physical and digital records and information management, and its data center division was built substantially through the January 2018 acquisition of IO Data Centers, confirmed in a press release filed as an SEC exhibit.

The company's data center site describes a global 1.4 gigawatt portfolio across more than 30 locations on three continents, twelve in North America, including Boston, Chicago, Denver, Kansas City, Northern Virginia, Ohio, and Phoenix, five in EMEA, including Amsterdam, Frankfurt, and London, and seven in Asia-Pacific, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Singapore. This 1.4 gigawatt figure places Iron Mountain among the larger capacity totals recorded in this registry, similar in scale to the campus-level figures reported by NTT and CloudHQ.

The registry here tracks 10 Iron Mountain facilities across three states, Arizona, Illinois, and Virginia, a small subset of the twelve North American markets named on the operator's site. Because Iron Mountain's data center business grew through acquiring IO Data Centers rather than only building new capacity, any Iron Mountain facility carrying legacy IO branding in this registry's records should be checked for a former_operator relationship during the facility-level research phase rather than assumed to be an original Iron Mountain build.
